title: Apple U2 / U3 Ultra-Wideband (UWB) Time-of-Flight (ToF) & Ranging Specification

tof_ranging_mechanics.ranging_mode: Double-Sided Two-Way Ranging (DS-TWR) & Round-Robin Ranging Mode (RRRM)
tof_ranging_mechanics.timing_resolution: Picosecond resolution (1 ps = 0.299792 mm distance equivalent)

first_path_search.algorithm: Leading Edge (LE) thresholding with dynamic noise floor estimation; distinguishes line-of-sight (LOS) direct path from delayed multipath wall reflections.

message_sequence.description: Pre-Poll synchronization frame establishing slot timing
Initiator transmits ranging poll with transmit timestamp T1
Responder receives at T2 and transmits response at T3
Initiator receives at T4, transmits final data with T1, T4 timestamps

two_way_ranging_exchange.tof_calculation_formula_ds_twr: ToF_ps = ((T_round1 * T_round2) - (T_reply1 * T_reply2)) / (T_round1 + T_round2 + T_reply1 + T_reply2)

evaluation_criteria: Phase coherence across receive antenna pairs

scrambled_timestamp_sequence_cryptograph.cipher: AES-128 in Counter Mode (CTR) producing pseudo-random ternary sequence {-1, 0, +1}

key_hierarchy.session_key: 128-bit ephemeral session key derived via ECDH
key_hierarchy.session_config: FiRa ranging block / slot parameters and channel profile

scrambled_timestamp_sequence_cryptograph.anti_spoofing_guarantee: By embedding pseudo-random STS pulses into the physical preamble, an attacker cannot predict future pulse polarity or inject early pulses without corrupting the CIR correlation peak, eliminating distance reduction attacks.
